title: Design: Unexported report keeps a long QuickBooks customer name inside its row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company that you can sign in to.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, already linked to a QuickBooks customer whose name is long with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest), so a QuickBooks customer with that long name is already taken.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, not linked to QuickBooks, whose name is exactly the name of customer D's QuickBooks customer.
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Open the Unexported report.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created in ShopView.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's invoice, billed to customer B, is listed with the reason "QuickBooks customer [that QuickBooks customer's name] is already linked to another ShopView customer."
  • The reason, with the long name, stays inside its own cell: no part of it covers the next column or the row under it.
  • Every column of the report is visible.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12319 (Story 17, QuickBooks sync)

  • S17-R4: “If that QuickBooks customer is already linked to another ShopView customer, the invoice is not sent and appears on the Unexported report with Q1.”
